signature: On bell garland: "IOSEPH HUSCHAUER / 17 IN WIENN 94."
dimensions: bo 10.8, be 117, le ca. 2695, height 1155, thickness of bell, diam. of mouthpiece receiver 11.9/11.1, mean bell thicknesses .30/.26/.28
provenance: Lent by A. Myers; ex coll W. Burger.
remarks: Flat bell-stay, pinned at bell-pipe end, soldered at joint end; fixed tubular slide stays; embellished garland and engraved bell-stay; simple turnings on ferrules; replacement pin to bell-stay; one sleeve patch on slide-bow; one sleeve patch on outer slide.
